newsitem.title: UK: BT, Space Hellas launch Concert in Greece.
newsitem.headline: BT, Space Hellas launch Concert in Greece.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Thursday it launched its Concert Packet networking services in Greece with Space Hellas SA as distributor.
Space Hellas will offer sales and support for companies requiring "international data connectivity", BT said in a statement.
BT said the addition of Space Hellas to its group of partnerships strengthened its presence in Southern Europe and completed Concert coverage of European Union countries.
Concert is a joint venture with U.S. telecom MCI Communications Corp that provides managed networks to businesses.

Space Hellas, which provides applications in data, voice and image communications in Greece, said the deal would complement its existing business distributing BT Syntegra financial trading systems and video-conferencing products.
